## Definition of done

- [ ] Tests: new behaviour is tested; a bug fix has a test that fails without it
- [ ] Docs: the pages describing this change are updated (`docs/doc-map.json`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] An ADR, if this makes or reverses an architectural decision
- [ ] `ENGINE_VERSION` bumped and an ADR added, if engine behaviour changed
- [ ] Findings register and roadmap updated, if this resolves or finds a problem
